first_error_evidence: Agent runs solver.py with only 15-second duration; the script (iterating C(40,6)=3,838,380 combinations per instance) exceeds this time budget and gets interrupted at step 6 before finishing all three instances.
verification_evidence: At step 9, the terminal output shows 'cat corner_counts.txt' returning three integer values (81618, 62762, 46940), confirming the output file was correctly generated before the agent claimed completion at step 10.
one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent correctly identified the task as a vertex enumeration problem and implemented a numpy+combinations brute-force script, but underestimated the runtime twice (15s then 60s duration allocations), causing terminal timing confusion and an unintended interruption of the first run before recovering and letting the script complete on the second run.
